prices.method: Daily bars from the stored grouped-daily files. 8EMA = EMA(8) of daily closes. 20D VWAP = sum(typical price x volume) / sum(volume) over 20 sessions, typical = (high+low+close)/3. 52W = up to the last 252 sessions (rows with fewer show the session count). A ticker whose last bar is older than the newest session shows that date and no derived metrics. Reference closes (since first buy / since filed) are n/a when the store does not cover that date.

clusters.rule: Cluster = 2 or more distinct insiders with open-market Form 4 code P buys of the same company, each within 10 days of the next. One row per company (newest cluster window; earlier windows counted). IPO/SPAC allocation suspects hidden by default (first daily bar within 30 days before the first buy, or a code C conversion in the same filing with a shared price).
